dedupe_keys.name: festival cleanup instances for the multi depot multi trip vehicle routing problem

description: Pascal Marquardt publishes 24 synthetic festival-cleanup instances for the Multi-Depot Multi-Trip Vehicle Routing Problem. Developed for a University of Vienna master's thesis, the instances represent waste collection after large events. Six size classes range from 23 to 1,000 collection points, with two depots in each instance. Node records contain an identifier, coordinates, service time and demand; depots precede collection points. Zenodo serves the benchmark files and a README in plain text under CC BY 4.0, free of charge. The format follows the Cordeau multi-depot routing convention described by the author. These are synthetic layouts without an observed geographical or historical coverage period. They can test routing algorithms and fleet-capacity assumptions, but they do not establish performance in a real festival. No related catalogue benchmark is explicitly identified.
